facts.fact: ContentLayers commits enabled_expansions and merged_database and emits expansion_state_changed before GameData reload. The facade ignores GameData.load_database() and returns only ContentLayers changed.
facts.failure_trigger: Any reload failure after an accepted expansion change, including content_layers_not_ready or a malformed merged/catalog authority.
facts.impact: Caller reports changed=true while GameData.is_loaded() is false after the current state-owner fix; there is no facade-level failure result or rollback of the expansion commit.

facts.fact: The mode ID is assigned before GameData reload and the bool is ignored. apply_mode returns true after a valid mode even when the reload fails.
facts.failure_trigger: A content package change followed by any GameData load failure.
facts.impact: mode state and ContentLayers expansion set can remain committed while GameData is unloaded; no save is performed here, but later profile/UI reads can observe the new mode.

facts.fact: Startup has an explicit ordered boundary and checks each bool. This is the legal Android/autoload-before-ready path and is separate from mode reload callers.
GameData refuses to load before ContentLayers is ready, clears _initial_load_complete at direct reload entry, and emits database_reloaded only after complete index/drop preparation succeeds.

Profile restore assigns mode fields, invokes GameModes.apply_mode without inspecting a reload failure, then applies the later-content expansion directly. Inventory/equipment restore continues after these calls.
facts.failure_trigger: A saved mode/package selection that causes GameData reload failure.
facts.impact: Restore has no explicit catalog-readiness gate before applying downstream saved inventory/equipment; the load result path must be checked by the caller before presenting the profile as usable.

facts.fact: Expansion mutation is the single ContentLayers state owner, but it has no transaction/rollback token tied to GameData load success.

signals_and_commit_order: ContentLayers.set_expansion_enabled mutates enabled_expansions and merged_database, then emits expansion_state_changed.
PlayerState.game_mode_id is assigned before GameData.load_database in GameModes.apply_mode.
GameData.load_database clears its loaded flag at entry and emits database_reloaded only on success.
PlayerState feature_catalog_changed is unrelated to these expansion/mode commits; it recalculates stats for feature publication only.

single_owner_recommendation.owner: ContentLayers + GameData coordinated reload boundary, with GameData load result as the admission result
minimal_complete_fix: Make GameModes.apply_mode return false unless every changed ContentLayers package is followed by a successful GameData.load_database; retain the prior mode ID until success or restore it on failure.

Make RuntimeServiceFacade return false for non-later expansion changes when GameData reload fails; either do not expose the expansion change or perform a ContentLayers rollback through its existing state owner.

During PlayerState profile restore, treat apply_mode failure as a load failure before applying inventory/equipment, preserving the existing save/load error owner rather than creating another catalog state.
Keep startup's ordered ContentLayers -> GameData bool gate unchanged.
do_not_do: Do not add a second GameData registry or PlayerState catalog cache.
Do not call arbitrary reset/retry loops to hide failure.

evidence_reuse: B07A GameData skill-book load rejection scene proves GameData false/load_error, partial index cleanup and direct reload loaded-state reset; it does not prove caller rollback.
StartupLoading's existing authoritative step checks are reusable for startup readiness only.
No native mode-reload negative test was added in this read-only audit.
